items.syllabus_item: 3.1 Compressive, tensile, bond, flexural strength, durability, impermeability

body.en:
Hardened concrete has set and developed a rigid matrix; hydration and strength development can continue when moisture and temperature are favourable. Compressive strength is resistance to crushing. Direct tensile strength is much lower and cracking often begins in tension; splitting or flexural tests are commonly used as indirect measures. Flexural strength (modulus of rupture) describes tensile resistance under bending. Bond strength is resistance to slip between concrete and reinforcement, depending on bar geometry, confinement and concrete condition.

Durability is the ability to resist environmental and service deterioration for the intended life; low permeability reduces movement of water and aggressive ions, but alone does not guarantee durability. Dense, adequately cured concrete with appropriate cover, exposure design and crack control is essential.
body.gu:
Hardened concrete set થઈ કઠોર matrix બને છે; અનુકૂળ moisture અને temperature હોય તો hydration તથા strength આગળ વધે છે. Compressive strength crushing સામેનો પ્રતિકાર છે. Direct tensile strength ઘણી ઓછી હોય છે; tensile વર્તન માટે splitting અથવા flexural tests વપરાય છે. Flexural strength અથવા modulus of rupture bending હેઠળ tensile resistance બતાવે છે. Bond strength reinforcement અને concrete વચ્ચે slip નો પ્રતિકાર છે; bar geometry, confinement અને concrete condition પર આધારિત છે.

Durability એટલે નિર્ધારિત service life દરમિયાન પર્યાવરણીય અને ઉપયોગથી થતા deterioration સામે ટકવાની ક્ષમતા; ઓછી permeability થી water અને aggressive ions નો પ્રવેશ ઘટે છે, પરંતુ તે એકલી પૂરતી નથી. Dense અને સારી રીતે cured concrete, યોગ્ય cover, exposure design અને crack control જરૂરી છે.

h.gu: 3.2 Compressive strength ને અસર કરતા factors

body.en: Effective water–cementitious ratio, binder properties, aggregate strength and grading, air content, compaction, curing, age and temperature all affect strength. For the same materials and adequate compaction, increasing effective water–cement ratio usually increases capillary porosity and reduces strength. Too little workable water without suitable admixture may leave voids and also reduce strength. Uncontrolled retempering, delayed placing, poor compaction and early drying cause variable results. Specimen shape, size, preparation, loading and curing also affect measured strength: compare like with like.
body.gu: Effective water–cementitious ratio, binder properties, aggregate strength તથા grading, air content, compaction, curing, age અને temperature strength ને અસર કરે છે. સમાન materials અને પૂરતા compaction સાથે effective ratio વધે તો capillary porosity સામાન્ય રીતે વધે અને strength ઘટે. યોગ્ય admixture વગર અતિ ઓછી workability થી voids રહી strength ઘટી શકે છે. નિયંત્રણ વગર retempering, મોડું placing, ખરાબ compaction અને વહેલું drying પરિણામમાં ફેરફાર લાવે છે. Specimen નું shape, size, preparation, loading અને curing પણ test result ને અસર કરે છે; સમાન conditions ની જ સરખામણી કરો.

items.syllabus_item: 3.3 BIS compressive and tensile tests, acceptance, mean and standard deviation

body.en:
Compression: obtain a representative fresh concrete sample, mould standard specimens, compact and cure under the applicable IS 516 test method, measure dimensions, then load centrally at the specified rate to failure. Strength is failure load divided by loaded area. A 150 mm cube has loaded area 22,500 mm². A test result is not automatically a single cube: the applicable sampling and specimen-averaging rules govern.

Splitting tension: load a cylinder along opposite longitudinal lines to failure; splitting strength is 2P/(πLD), where P is failure load, L cylinder length and D diameter. Flexural testing applies prescribed loading and uses the appropriate rupture equation; do not apply a centre-point expression to third-point loading. Consult the relevant current IS 516 parts.

Acceptance: characteristic cube strength fck is the value below which not more than 5% of results are expected to fall. Acceptance compares eligible consecutive sample results and individual results using the current IS 456 clauses and amendments, not a single arbitrary cube against the mix-design target. Check grade-specific table, sample count, strength-age and rounding rules in the project’s applicable code; amendments matter. For illustration only, if the applicable specification sets a four-sample group minimum of 28.5 MPa and an individual minimum of 22 MPa, four consecutive results 29, 30, 28 and 31 MPa have a mean of 29.5 MPa and a minimum of 28 MPa; both specified checks pass. Confirm the limits and sampling provisions for the actual project. If results fail, follow the engineer’s investigation and code procedure, not automatic demolition or unconditional acceptance.
body.gu:
Compression: Fresh concrete નો representative sample લો, લાગુ IS 516 method પ્રમાણે standard specimens mould, compact અને cure કરો, dimensions માપી નિર્ધારિત rate પર centrally failure સુધી load કરો. Strength = failure load / loaded area. 150 mm cube નું loaded area 22,500 mm² છે. Test result આપોઆપ એક cube નથી: લાગુ sampling અને specimen-averaging rules અનુસરો.

Splitting tension: Cylinder પર બે વિરુદ્ધ longitudinal lines પર failure સુધી load કરો; splitting strength = 2P/(πLD), જ્યાં P failure load, L cylinder length અને D diameter છે. Flexural test માં prescribed loading તથા યોગ્ય rupture equation વાપરો; centre-point નું સૂત્ર third-point loading માટે ન વાપરો. લાગુ current IS 516 parts તપાસો.

Acceptance: Characteristic cube strength fck એ એવી કિંમત છે જેની નીચે 5% કરતાં વધુ પરિણામો આવવાની અપેક્ષા નથી. Acceptance માટે current IS 456 અને amendments મુજબ યોગ્ય consecutive sample results તથા individual results તપાસો; એક cube ને mix-design target સાથે સરખાવવું પૂરતું નથી. Grade-specific table, samples ની સંખ્યા, age અને rounding rules તપાસો. માત્ર ઉદાહરણ તરીકે, લાગુ specification ચાર sample ના group માટે minimum 28.5 MPa અને individual minimum 22 MPa આપે તો સતત 29, 30, 28 અને 31 MPa results નો mean 29.5 MPa અને minimum 28 MPa છે; આપેલી બંને checks પાસ થાય છે. વાસ્તવિક project માટે limits અને sampling provisions ચકાસો. Failure થાય તો engineer ની તપાસ તથા code procedure અનુસરો; આપોઆપ તોડવું કે બિનશરતી સ્વીકારવું નહીં.

body.en: Mean strength is the arithmetic average of a set of comparable results. Sample standard deviation measures dispersion about that mean; for n independent results, the usual sample calculation divides the sum of squared deviations by n − 1. Use the eligible production population and code-specific rules for establishing standard deviation. A larger standard deviation requires a larger margin in mix proportioning; a small or unrepresentative group should not be treated as established production variability. Target mean strength for mix design and acceptance criteria are separate decisions.
body.gu: Mean strength એ સરખાવી શકાય તેવા results ની arithmetic average છે. Sample standard deviation mean આસપાસના spread નું માપ છે; n independent results માટે સામાન્ય sample calculation માં squared deviations નો સરવાળો n − 1 વડે ભાગાય છે. Standard deviation સ્થાપિત કરવા યોગ્ય production population અને code rules વાપરો. વધુ standard deviation માટે mix proportioning માં વધુ margin જરૂરી બને છે; નાનો કે બિનપ્રતિનિધિ group સ્થાપિત variability નથી. Mix-design target mean strength અને acceptance criteria જુદા નિર્ણયો છે.

items.syllabus_item: 3.4 creep and shrinkage, effects and factors

body.en: Creep is time-dependent additional strain under sustained stress. It increases long-term deflection and redistributes stress; it depends on stress, age at loading, humidity, paste content, aggregate stiffness and curing. Shrinkage is time-dependent reduction in volume not caused by sustained external load; plastic, drying and autogenous mechanisms differ. Restraint of shrinkage can cause cracking. Reduce risks with suitable mix, curing, joints, reinforcement and sound detailing; creep and shrinkage are not the same as elastic strain.
body.gu: Creep એટલે sustained stress હેઠળ સમય સાથે વધતો strain. તે long-term deflection અને stress redistribution વધારે છે; stress, loading સમયે age, humidity, paste, aggregate stiffness તથા curing પર આધારિત છે. Shrinkage sustained external load વગર સમય સાથે volume ઘટવું છે; plastic, drying અને autogenous mechanisms જુદા છે. Shrinkage ને restraint હોય તો cracks પડી શકે. યોગ્ય mix, curing, joints, reinforcement અને detailing થી જોખમ ઘટાડો; creep અને shrinkage ને elastic strain સાથે સરખાં ન માનવાં.

body.en: Durability depends on exposure and design life, water–binder ratio, binder selection, concrete cover, compaction, curing, crack width, drainage and construction quality. Chloride ingress may initiate reinforcement corrosion; carbonation lowers alkalinity; sulphates can cause expansive attack; freeze–thaw damage depends on exposure and suitable air-void system. Dense concrete, appropriate material and exposure design, drainage and crack control work together. Strength alone does not establish suitability for aggressive exposure.
body.gu: Durability exposure અને design life, water–binder ratio, binder selection, concrete cover, compaction, curing, crack width, drainage અને construction quality પર આધારિત છે. Chloride ingress થી reinforcement corrosion શરૂ થઈ શકે; carbonation alkalinity ઘટાડે છે; sulphates થી expansive attack થઈ શકે; freeze–thaw damage exposure અને યોગ્ય air-void system પર આધારિત છે. Dense concrete, યોગ્ય material તથા exposure design, drainage અને crack control સાથે કામ કરે છે. માત્ર strength થી aggressive exposure ની suitability નક્કી થતી નથી.

h.en: 3.7 NDT: rebound hammer and ultrasonic pulse velocity
h.gu: 3.7 NDT: rebound hammer અને ultrasonic pulse velocity

body.en:
Non-destructive testing (NDT) helps survey uniformity, locate suspect areas and monitor changes while causing little or no damage. The rebound hammer measures surface rebound, affected by surface preparation, moisture, carbonation, test direction and aggregate; it is not a direct universal strength measurement. Develop a suitable correlation with cores or calibrated specimens when estimating strength.

Ultrasonic pulse velocity (UPV): transducers send and receive a pulse; velocity equals path length divided by travel time. Direct transmission on opposite faces is usually most reliable; semi-direct and indirect arrangements have limitations. Cracks, voids, moisture, reinforcement, path length and coupling affect readings. Neither NDT method alone proves design strength or identifies all defects. Use current IS 13311 relevant parts, calibration, a test plan and engineering interpretation; combine with cores when necessary.
body.gu:
Non-destructive testing (NDT) થી બહુ ઓછા કે વગર નુકસાન concrete ની uniformity તપાસી, શંકાસ્પદ વિસ્તારો શોધી અને ફેરફારનું monitoring કરી શકાય છે. Rebound hammer surface rebound માપે છે; surface preparation, moisture, carbonation, test direction અને aggregate તેને અસર કરે છે. તે સાર્વત્રિક સીધું strength measurement નથી; strength estimate માટે cores અથવા calibrated specimens સાથે યોગ્ય correlation બનાવો.

Ultrasonic pulse velocity (UPV): Transducers pulse મોકલે અને મેળવે છે; velocity = path length / travel time. સામેની faces વચ્ચે direct transmission સામાન્ય રીતે વધુ વિશ્વસનીય છે; semi-direct અને indirect arrangements ની મર્યાદા છે. Cracks, voids, moisture, reinforcement, path length અને coupling reading ને અસર કરે છે. કોઈ એક NDT method એકલી design strength સાબિત કરતી નથી કે બધા defects શોધતી નથી. હાલના IS 13311 ના લાગુ parts, calibration, test plan અને engineering interpretation વાપરો; જરૂર પડે cores સાથે જોડો.

title.gu: Ultrasonic pulse velocity test ની આકૃતિ

body.en:
Given: A 150 mm cube fails at 675 kN. Find compressive strength.

Step 1. Find the loaded area.

A = 150 × 150A = 22500 mm²

Step 2. Convert load and divide by area.

P = 675 × 1000P = 675000 Nf = P / Af = 675000 / 22500

Final answer:

Compressive strength = 30 N/mm²
body.gu:
આપેલ છે: 150 mm cube 675 kN load પર fail થાય છે. Compressive strength શોધો.

Step 1. Loaded area ગણો.

A = 150 × 150A = 22500 mm²

Step 2. Load ને N માં ફેરવી area થી ભાગો.

P = 675 × 1000P = 675000 Nf = P / Af = 675000 / 22500

અંતિમ જવાબ:

Compressive strength = 30 N/mm²

title.gu: Numerical 3.2 — Splitting tensile strength ની ગણતરી

body.en:
Given: A cylinder 150 mm in diameter and 300 mm long fails at 210 kN in splitting. Find splitting tensile strength.

Step 1. Write the splitting expression.

ft = 2P / (πLD)

Step 2. Substitute N and mm.

ft = 2 × 210000 / (π × 300 × 150)

Final answer:

Splitting tensile strength ≈ 2.97 N/mm²
body.gu:
આપેલ છે: 150 mm diameter અને 300 mm લાંબો cylinder splitting માં 210 kN પર fail થાય છે. Splitting tensile strength ગણો.

Step 1. Splitting નું સૂત્ર લખો.

ft = 2P / (πLD)

Step 2. N અને mm માં કિંમત મૂકો.

ft = 2 × 210000 / (π × 300 × 150)

અંતિમ જવાબ:

Splitting tensile strength ≈ 2.97 N/mm²

body.en:
Given: Direct UPV path is 0.30 m and measured travel time is 75 microseconds. Find velocity.

Step 1. Convert time to seconds.

t = 75 × 10⁻⁶ s

Step 2. Divide path by travel time.

V = L / tV = 0.30 / (75 × 10⁻⁶)

Final answer:

UPV = 4000 m/s = 4.0 km/s
body.gu:
આપેલ છે: Direct UPV path 0.30 m અને travel time 75 microseconds છે. Velocity શોધો.

Step 1. Time ને seconds માં ફેરવો.

t = 75 × 10⁻⁶ s

Step 2. Path ને travel time થી ભાગો.

V = L / tV = 0.30 / (75 × 10⁻⁶)

અંતિમ જવાબ:

UPV = 4000 m/s = 4.0 km/s

q.en: What is fck?
q.gu: fck શું છે?

a.en: Strength below which not more than 5% of results are expected.
a.gu: એવી strength કે જેની નીચે 5% થી વધુ results અપેક્ષિત નથી.

q.en: What is bond strength?
q.gu: Bond strength શું છે?

a.en: Resistance to slip between concrete and reinforcement.
a.gu: Concrete અને reinforcement વચ્ચે slip નો પ્રતિકાર.

q.en: Does higher w/c usually increase strength?
q.gu: વધુ w/c સામાન્ય રીતે strength વધારે છે?

a.en: No, with comparable materials and adequate compaction.
a.gu: નહીં, સમાન materials અને પૂરતા compaction હેઠળ.

q.en: What is cube strength?
q.gu: Cube strength શું છે?

a.en: Failure load divided by loaded area.

q.en: Is one cube always one test result?
q.gu: એક cube હંમેશા એક test result છે?

a.gu: નહીં; specimen averaging rules લાગુ પડે છે.

q.en: What is creep?
q.gu: Creep શું છે?

a.gu: Sustained stress હેઠળ સમય સાથે વધતો strain.

q.en: What is shrinkage?
q.gu: Shrinkage શું છે?

a.en: Volume reduction not caused by sustained external load.
a.gu: Sustained external load વગર volume માં ઘટાડો.

q.en: Why is cover important?
q.gu: Cover કેમ મહત્વનું છે?

a.en: It protects reinforcement from exposure and provides bond.
a.gu: તે reinforcement ને exposure સામે રક્ષણ અને bond આપે છે.

q.en: What is NDT?
q.gu: NDT શું છે?

a.en: Testing with little or no damage to the member.
a.gu: Member ને બહુ ઓછા કે વગર નુકસાન testing.

q.en: What does a rebound hammer measure?
q.gu: Rebound hammer શું માપે છે?

a.gu: Surface rebound, જે indirect indicator છે.

q.en: What is UPV?
q.gu: UPV શું છે?

q.en: Does UPV alone prove design strength?
q.gu: UPV એકલું design strength સાબિત કરે છે?

a.en: No; interpretation and other evidence are needed.
a.gu: નહીં; interpretation અને અન્ય પુરાવા જરૂરી છે.
